title: Compact contextual overview and ARIA narration for dense time-series
creator: Maya Rivera
description: Problem: Our dense time-series widgets (mini-sparklines and bandlines) are visually compact but provide poor keyboard and screen-reader affordances. Current legend/tooltips introduce large DOM and event handlers which blow up render cost in dashboards with hundreds of series. Goal: design a compact contextual overview component that provides an at-a-glance sparkline, an inline semantic summary, and an optional ARIA-first narration mode for screen readers. The component must be keyboard-first, minimize DOM nodes, and support progressive aggregation (decimation) for performance budgets.
acceptance_criteria: CompactOverview component spec drafted in Figma with 3 density variants (compact, cozy, expanded)
ARIA narration pattern documented with example utterances and live-region usage
Prototype built in storybook demonstrating keyboard-only navigation, focus states, and narration toggle
Performance budget: initial paint for a page with 200 CompactOverview components < 2s on medium devices (measured in lab)
Integration checklist for dev: token mapping, DOM reduction guidance, and fallback for browsers without aria-live support
design_decisions: Use a single canvas for rendering the sparkline path + annotations to reduce DOM; interactive layer uses a lightweight focusable invisible button for each series
Prefer aria-live polite summaries on focus rather than continuous live updates to avoid screen reader spam
Provide precomputed summary strings from server-side/eval tooling when available to avoid client recomputation on initial render
Expose three semantic summary levels (one-line headline, three-bullet breakdown, full textual narration) selectable by user preference
Limit tooltip/legend DOM to on-demand overlay that is only mounted when keyboard or pointer interaction occurs
implementation_notes: Front-end: implement CompactOverview canvas renderer with offscreen buffering and requestAnimationFrame batching
Back-end: add optional /summaries endpoint for time-series pre-aggregated textual summaries (gradual rollout)
Tokens: spacing and color palette use existing chart tokens; add new token chart.sparkline.stroke-width-compact and chart.aria.narration.enabled
Provide two code examples in Storybook: (1) keyboard-first narration toggle; (2) bulk dashboard with virtualization to validate perf
Measurements: integrate Lighthouse + custom lab harness to record initial paint and CPU time per 100 components
dependencies: PM-780 (product: accessibility patterns review and release timeline)
